purpose: Read-only discovery and validation preflight for the existing optional_licensed_eod_provider. This artifact does not promote, stage, or write canonical market rows.

urlTemplateSubstitutions.{limit}: 250 in the current G11 probeLicensedCurrent implementation

providerDiscovery.dateRequestBehavior: No date parameter is injected by the adapter. Returned JSON is recursively parsed and then filtered to the exact target session.
providerDiscovery.successRequirement: HTTP response.ok plus valid JSON plus an exact target-session row plus validateCurrentRow().ok

numericRules.parser: parseNumber strips comma/percent/Arabic-comma/whitespace and parses a decimal numeric token
numericRules.ohlc: must all be positive and satisfy high/low/open/close invariants
numericRules.volume: must be finite and >= 0; missing volume is rejected
numericRules.integerVolumeRequirementForThisPreflight: Not yet provable because no provider response is available. Any non-integer/rounded/ambiguous volume remains ineligible even if the generic adapter parses it.

identityRules.returnedSymbolRule: When provider returns symbol/ticker/code, it must equal the requested ticker after safeTicker normalization.
identityRules.importantLimitation: The current adapter can accept a row whose JSON object contains no sourceSymbol. For this recovery preflight, independent exact identity must still be established before canonical eligibility.

finalizationSemantics.currentAdapterBehavior: Treats a matching historical JSON row as a candidate; it does not inspect an explicit EOD/finalized flag.
finalizationSemantics.recoveryRequirement: Provider endpoint/schema semantics must demonstrate that the returned 2026-09-17 record is a finalized EOD historical bar before eligibility. No new finalization rule is invented here.

environment.note: No credential value was read, logged, or persisted. The absence of an effective URL is sufficient to block a provider request.

readOnlyValidation.reason: EGX_HISTORY_API_URL_NOT_CONFIGURED in the latest persisted G11 provider registry; no endpoint can be constructed safely.

dryRun.reason: EHDR read-only provider request could not be executed because the effective provider URL is not configured.

currentSessionGaps.reason: Phase 6 is gated on successful EHDR provider-contract validation.

rejectedRows.reason: Provider URL not configured; no request executed and no market data was returned.

nextAction: Configure a licensed EOD endpoint in the existing EGX_HISTORY_API_URL GitHub secret (and EGX_HISTORY_API_KEY only if that endpoint requires Bearer auth), then run a read-only EHDR/2026-09-17 probe against the exact existing adapter contract before any staging or canonical write.
